title: CloudEventEnvelope
description: Standardized CloudEvents-compliant envelope for GoCart domain events.

event_id.description: Unique identifier of the event (deduplication key).

event_type.description: Canonical name of the domain event.

aggregate_id.description: Identifier of the domain aggregate root (partition routing key).

event_version.description: Schema version of the event envelope.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the event occurred (ISO 8601 / RFC 3339).

correlation_id.description: End-to-end correlation ID across distributed systems.
